title.en: Knowledgeable, attentive, and supportive dog trainers

text.en: Dog owners consistently commend trainers Wesley and Anthony for their deep expertise, patience, and engaging teaching style in Houston. Clients emphasize that the trainers focus equally on educating human owners, providing actionable advice and explanations. Reviewers describe the staff as dedicated professionals who genuinely care about each family's long-term success.

title.en: Noticeable obedience, calmness, and impulse control

text.en: Clients report dramatic improvements in their dogs after completing board-and-train and private programs. Owners highlight mastered commands such as place, heel, and recall, alongside significantly calmer demeanors at home and reduced reactivity around distractions. Families emphasize that their dogs return confident, settled, and much more responsive to direction.

title.en: Regular video updates and responsive guidance

text.en: Reviewers praise the trainers for maintaining transparent and consistent communication throughout all training programs. Owners receiving board-and-train services highlight frequent video updates and demonstrations showing their dog's daily progress and behavioral corrections. Clients appreciate that trainers answer questions thoroughly and remain accessible for ongoing advice.

q.en: Does Good DaweG provide board-and-train programs?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently enroll dogs in comprehensive multi-week board-and-train programs tailored to obedience and impulse control.

q.en: Are owners sent video updates during board-and-train stays?

a.en: Yes, reviewers emphasize receiving regular training videos and explanations showcasing their dog's daily milestones.

q.en: Are in-home private training lessons offered?

a.en: Yes, trainers conduct private in-home lessons to address everyday behavioral challenges directly in the home environment.
